introHtml: Cardboard pen and pencil sets offer a sustainable alternative to plastic packaging, making them ideal for eco-conscious brands and budget-friendly giveaways. The natural kraft finish provides a clean canvas for your logo or message using screen printing or foil stamping. Whether you need a simple writing set for a job fair or a recycled option for an Earth Day promotion, these sets combine practicality with a low environmental footprint.
